messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: meridian-prod (VPC) - Increased 5xx rate from tenant pool (dedicated-gpu-7). Pager routed to oncall-ryan at 5533331000.
oncall-ryan: I'm on it. Initial look: error spike started ~5533330900, latency up ~2.1x.
sre-maya: Logs show repeated KV cache misses + OOMs on worker-3 in dedicated-gpu-7. Storage IO looks normal.
eng-lucas: Confirming model runtime reports: version meridian-llm@v1.2.8 has been evicted repeatedly, fallback attempts failing with decode errors.
customer-success-ana: Heads-up: MeridianCorp reported elevated end-user failure rate, they are in a live demo in 30m. Need quick mitigation and comms.
oncall-ryan: Plan: 1) Pin tenant to last-known-good safe variant (v1.2.3-safe). 2) Enable routed fallback to quantized-safe variant in the same pool. 3) Open a short-lived circuit on worker-3. Who can execute pins now?
eng-lucas: I can run the pin and enable safe fallback. Will coordinate with platform-eli for routing changes.
platform-eli: I'll cut routing rule to avoid worker-3 and mark it draining. Also will kick a targeted restart if drain doesn't help.
eng-lucas: Running pin now: ```
redwoodctl tenants meridian pin --model meridian-llm@v1.2.3-safe --scope tenant --reason "emergency fallback - v1.2.8 eviction" 
```
eng-lucas: Pin command returned 200, target config applied. TTL=4h.
sre-maya: Enabling fallback policy route: ```
redwoodctl routing update --pool dedicated-gpu-7 --fallback quantized-meridian@v1.2.3-q8 --priority 50
```
sre-maya: Fallback route activated. Starting 30s canary to verify responses.
eng-lucas: Canary looks clean, token errors dropped to baseline. Latency down to ~1.05x.
oncall-ryan: Great. I'll notify MeridianCorp: "We've pinned your tenant to a safe variant and enabled a quantized fallback. We're monitoring; will keep you updated in 15m."
acct-ops-jordan: Documenting intervention for billing/incident window. Please tag this thread with incident ID: INC-2026-7231.
customer-success-ana: I'm sending the customer note now and asking them to validate demo flows.
platform-eli: Worker-3 draining; if no further OOMs in 10m we'll bring it back as standby.
sre-maya: Collecting heap profiles and runtime logs and uploading to /incidents/5533331000/artifacts. Will share link in 10m.
oncall-ryan: Handoff: I'm staying on pager for the next 30m, then hand to sre-maya for monitoring. If any regression, escalate to eng-lucas.
eng-lucas: Agreed. Postmortem checklist: root-cause hypothesis = model memory regression in v1.2.8 under certain sequence patterns + KV cache eviction race. Will start repro ASAP.
customer-success-ana: Customer confirms demo flows okay. They appreciate the fast response.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: RESOLVED (mitigation applied) - auto-annotation added INC-2026-7231 resolved_by_pin.
oncall-ryan: Closing loop: create a short after-action note with timeline + commands used and link to artifacts. Assign to eng-lucas for root-cause.
eng-lucas: Will draft and drop into #postmortems in 2 hours.
platform-eli: Leaving worker-3 in draining until tomorrow morning, will coordinate a repro window during low traffic.
sre-maya: Monitoring continues. If metrics hold for 60m, we'll mark incident cleared.
oncall-ryan: Thanks all. :thumbsup:
